page.overview:
Who is Navi?

Navi is a girl with dark skin, lavender eyebrows and eyelashes, white fingernails and pale pink hair in two ponytails with lavender inner parts, giving her hair the appearance of rabbit ears. She has large eyes with irises that are half lavender and half hot pink with a white horizontal stripe in the middle. She wears a white bow on top of her head, a hot pink, light pink, purple and green horizontal-striped shirt, a grey belt, hot pink pants with white baggy shorts over them, and white shoes with orange soles. She also wears a green band on her left wrist.
